messages:
Alex Kim: Quick sync 1: Sales pinged about proration rules for committed credits when customers change commits mid-cycle. Need a clear, ship-able decision.
Priya Shah: Agree. Let's list scenarios: increase commit, decrease commit, SKU swap, enable/disable burst credits. My proposed rule: increases = pro-rate immediate credit; decreases = effective next billing cycle unless approved.
Tomás Rivera: From ops POV that's reasonable. We can auto-calc increases. For decreases we need an approval flow to prevent gaming. Also we need a mapping: route_id -> commit_id -> billing_key.
LegalBot: Draft clause suggestion: "No retroactive refunds for decreases in committed capacity unless explicitly approved in writing by Redwood Finance." Also include a sample tolerances table.
Sam O'Neill: Legacy question: what about existing reserved customers on grandfathered softcaps? Propose migration path: opt-in within 6 months for new ledger behavior; otherwise keep legacy terms until renewal.
Alex Kim: Launch gating (must-have): (1) invoice export includes SLA addon as distinct line item, (2) UI shows credit ledger and per-commit history, (3) contract sample and FAQ for Sales. Pilot with Dedicated customers first.
Priya Shah: Dev estimate: ledger + export schema -> 2 sprints; UI + export views -> 1 sprint; docs + FAQ -> 1 sprint. We can compress if we cut initial UI to minimal CSV export.
Tomás Rivera: Rollout concerns: we need a manual-override for finance, and a rollback plan if export format breaks downstream ETL. I'll add a migration script for legacy invoices.
Alex Kim: Can we show an example invoice line for the export?
Tomás Rivera: Example (JSON): {"line_items":[{"code":"SLA_ADDON","amount":-500,"currency":"USD","period":"2026-07"}]}
Priya Shah: Good. For analytics we should keep credits in a separate ledger so they don't reduce reported usage metrics. Avoid double-dipping.
LegalBot: Also flag: Sales occasionally requests pro-rate for decreases as a concession. If we allow that, require an approval ticket with sign-off. Document approval SLAs.
Sam O'Neill: Pilot candidate list: Acme Inc., NimbusAI, BrightLabs. I'll reach out to Sales to confirm their willingness to join pilot.
ops-bot: billing-pipeline v2 scheduled deploy 2026-07-30 03:00 UTC 15m maintenance window for export infra.
Alex Kim: Timeline: target pilot start 4 weeks post-deploy. Action items: @Priya add PRD section + table of scenarios; @Tomás add export schema + migration script; @Sam confirm pilot customers; @LegalBot finalize clause + approval flow. Check back in 1 week. :thumbsup:
Priya Shah: I'll put the table in PRD: columns = trigger, affected customers, pro-rate allowed (Y/N), manual-override required.
Tomás Rivera: I'll open the repo PR with the schema draft today.
Sam O'Neill: On it 1 I'll also draft email to Sales asking for pilot opt-in.
LegalBot: Draft clause will be in Confluence by EOD tomorrow.
